card: RX 7900 XTX (fabric j3211 + j3213 hipx, confounded=false)
summary: Node bench (standalone hipcc harness built for gfx1100, bit-identical to gemm_bf16_xf32_batched/_xbf16_batched at every row count 1..4096, odd M/K/N included; guard run j3210 OK). Selector shape (M17 K10240, BF16 x). 4 rows/CTA vs 8 rows/CTA, us per call (p4/p8): N=896 43.9/50.4, N=1024 47.5/44.2: p4 wins at 896, p8 from N=1024. Previous route (gemm_bf16_xf32_batched, the only BF16 route on gfx1100) measured 13-3548 us (router) / 32-1453 us (selector) over the swept row counts; the small-rows kernels are 2.8x-18x faster at every measured row count.
